subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and port the open fork PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks starting a second automated fix lane.

options.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, updating it for the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path and current proof expectations.

options.title: Request a fresh PR
options.body: Close the fork PR as superseded and ask for a new same-repository UI-only resolver fix with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, updating it for the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path and current proof expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: They are most directly tied to the channel UI/catalog refactor and current Channels view move shown in git history.
